title: Accessible Freshwater Is 0.007 Percent Of Earth's Water
hook: Almost all freshwater is locked away before it can reach a tap.
closing: That tiny accessible share makes protecting rivers and lakes matter to every community.
question: Would you have guessed this small?

segments.say: Freshwater makes up 3.5 percent of Earth's water, leaving almost everything else salty.
Glaciers and ice caps hold 68.7 percent of freshwater, locking most of it beyond easy reach.
Rivers and lakes hold 0.007 percent of Earth's water, supplying much of what people can readily reach.
